statements.statement: CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered for the patient
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
The service raised concern for intermittent arrhythmia
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate the patient's symptoms with potential arrhythmic events
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
